The '''''Ambria's Fury''''' was an [[Imperial warship]] belonging to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that participated in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Ambria" /> in [[3665 BBY]].<ref name="Gnost" /> The ship's cargo was unknown to most of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], but high-ranking [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] were distressed when the ''Fury'' was shot down over the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Ambria" /> during the last days of the massive battle.<ref name="Gnost" /> It crashed in the northern end of the [[Glacial Fissure]] region, breaking in half but remaining largely intact,<ref name="Ambria" /> and it was later discovered that among the ''Fury''{{'s}} cargo were several power cores that could be used in [[HK-51 series assassin droid|HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]].<ref name="Assertion">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Assertion: Repairs Required|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref><ref name="Directive">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Directive: Activate Assassination Protocols for Empire|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|As a side note: For some reason a lot of players seem to think that The ''Fatality'' wreck is located on Hoth. We cannot explain and are baffled by this impression, as the wreck in question on Hoth is clearly the ''Ambria's Fury''. It must just be some mass delusion brought on by the Dread Masters.|Jesse Sky|<ref name="Blog">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20121114|text=Developer Update: Section X and HK-51 Missions in Game Update 1.5}}</ref>}}
The ''Ambria's Fury'' was originally titled the ''[[Fatality]]'', a ship that contained a legion of [[HK-51 series assassin droid|HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], but the name in the ship's Codex entry was later changed in Game Update 1.5 when the wreck of the ''Fatality'' was moved to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Blog" />
